title: ESQL: Limit the size of shapes in MV_SLICE tests

timeline.message:
ESQL: Limit the size of shapes in MV_SLICE tests

This limits the size of the data used to test MV_SLICE so we don't run
out of memory when testing it.

Closes #109697
timeline.author: Nik Everett
